title: Fresh Eggless Strawberry Cream Cake
summary: Soft moist vanilla sponge layered with Mahabaleshwar strawberry crush, whipped non-dairy cream, and fresh strawberry slices.

Superfine Powdered Sugar
Double Action Baking Powder
Pure Edible Baking Soda
Amul Masti Dahi Curd
Fortune Sunlite Refined Sunflower Cooking Oil
Sprig Natural Bourbon Vanilla Extract

Mapro Whole Fruit Strawberry Crush
Rich's Non-Dairy Whip Topping Cream
Oddy Ecobake Non-Stick Baking Parchment Paper
HomeBasics Anodized Aluminium Round Cake Pan 8-inch

content:
An authentic bakery-style layered strawberry gateau prepared without eggs.
1. Sponge Aeration: Whisk curd and powdered sugar until smooth, then add baking powder and baking soda. Let rest for 5 minutes until frothy bubbles form.
2. Wet & Dry Fold: Gently fold in oil, vanilla extract, and sifted maida flour without over-beating.
3. Bake: Pour into parchment-lined 8-inch cake tin and bake at 180°C for 30-35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
4. Assembly: Slice cooled sponge into 2 layers. Soak each layer with water-diluted strawberry crush. Pipe chilled whipped cream, lay fresh strawberry slices, and frost the exterior.

content:

title: Eggless Baking Substitution Rules & Ratios
summary: Comprehensive scientific conversion ratios for replacing whole eggs in cake sponges, cookies, and brownies.
content:
When baking eggless, eggs provide three primary functions: Moisture, Leavening (lift), and Emulsification (binding).
Use these exact substitutions per 1 large egg:
1. Dahi/Curd or Greek Yogurt: 1/4 cup (60g) thick curd + 1/4 tsp baking soda. Excellent for soft fluffy vanilla and fruit sponges.
2. Sweetened Condensed Milk: 1/4 cup (60g) condensed milk (reduce recipe sugar by 2 tablespoons). Provides rich caramel crumb and tender moisture.
3. Flax Egg (Vegan): 1 tbsp (10g) ground golden flaxseed powder + 3 tbsp warm water. Whisk and rest for 10 minutes until gelatinous. Superb for chocolate cakes, brownies, and nutty breads.
4. Vinegar & Baking Soda Reaction: 1 tbsp white vinegar or apple cider vinegar + 1 tsp baking soda. Chemical reaction releases carbon dioxide, producing tall airy sponge cakes without eggs.
5. Mashed Banana: 1/4 cup ripe banana. Best for pancakes and tea loaves (adds slight banana flavor).

title: Gluten-Free Flour Selection & Cross-Contamination Rules
summary: Rules for choosing gluten-free flours and binders (almond, oat, tapioca, rice) and avoiding wheat cross-contact.
content:
Gluten provides elasticity and traps gas in baked goods. To replace wheat flour safely:
1. Almond Flour: 100% grain-free blanched ground almonds. High protein and healthy fats. Best for soft cakes, macarons, and keto baking.
2. Certified Gluten-Free Oat Flour: Rich in soluble fiber, gives familiar bakery chewiness. Must be certified gluten-free to avoid cross-contamination in grain mills.
3. Tapioca Starch / Corn Starch: Added in 15-20% ratio to gluten-free flour blends to mimic gluten's stretch and prevent crumbly texture.
4. Xanthan Gum or Psyllium Husk: Add 1/2 tsp per cup of gluten-free flour to provide tensile strength.
